api.title: El backoff no olvidaba fallos antiguos bajo 10000 claves
api.before: La limpieza de registros caducados solo se ejecutaba al llenar la tabla, conservando el contador de fallos indefinidamente con carga ordinaria.
api.fix: Al comprobar una clave se descarta su registro después de 60 minutos sin fallos, antes de aplicar backoff o reservar cupo.

infrastructure.before: The documented external PostgreSQL configuration used pg without TLS unless undocumented driver environment variables were set. Pure source/driver probe returned ssl=false without opening a connection.
infrastructure.fix: Production requires PGSSLMODE=verify-full. pg uses verify-full+sslrootcert, CLI uses require+sslaccept=strict+sslcert for a private CA. The real fixture uncovered the CA parameter distinction; regression and minimum fix verified.
infrastructure.regression: postgres.spec.ts source/driver regression red then green. tls/resultado.json: 9 real checks on synthetic PostgreSQL17, pg/adapter-pg/PrismaCLI each connect with correct CA/SAN and reject false CA and wrong SAN. Temporary container+anonymous volume removed after matching name+task label.
infrastructure.limit: Real TLS behavior verified only in isolated local synthetic fixture. No external provider hostname/CA, managed backup or actual customer data used.

infrastructure.before: Local synthetic /salud responded with X-Powered-By: Express and lacked global security/cache headers.
infrastructure.fix: Shared middleware before JSON parser adds nosniff, DENY, no-referrer, restrictive CSP and no-store; disables X-Powered-By; HSTS only for trusted HTTPS. Existing explicit media cache policies remain authoritative.
infrastructure.regression: Real Nest HTTP tests cover 200, 404 and malformed JSON 400, plus trusted proxy HTTPS; failed before fix.

infrastructure.before: Production accepted short JWT secrets, local photo storage and a sandbox or missing mail sender; missing mail key surfaced only at first send.
infrastructure.fix: JWT helper requires at least 32 non-whitespace characters in production; local storage rejected in production; mail sender must be explicit, nonblank and outside resend.dev; key required at service construction.
infrastructure.regression: entorno.spec.ts, almacen-configurado.spec.ts, correo-produccion.spec.ts; red functional failures recorded before fixes.
infrastructure.limit: Minimum secret length does not prove entropy. Mail guard does not prove DNS verification or delivery.

infrastructure.before: The privileged seed accepted a one-character password and invalid email; an existing customer account using the seed email produced success without an entrenador.
infrastructure.fix: Reuse shared email/password schemas and reject an existing non-entrenador account; preserve an existing trainer without reading or replacing its password.
infrastructure.regression: Five source-import tests with mocked Prisma/Argon2, no DB or mail. Three functional failures reproduced before fix.

infrastructure.before: F09 deleted training sessions without first removing novedades and their lecturas, violating current restrictive foreign keys after moving/sending.
infrastructure.fix: Delete only readings and novedades of synthetic session IDs before deleting sessions.
infrastructure.regression: Execute actual cleanup function in a VM with a lazy transactional Prisma double enforcing the real FK order; red then green.

infrastructure.before: Legacy walkthroughs printed failures while returning successful process status.
infrastructure.fix: Exit code 1 for any failure; leftover synthetic users also count as a failure.
infrastructure.regression: VM executes actual summaries for 0, 1 and 4 failures, no providers/DB.

infrastructure.before: Legacy scripts inherited the ordinary .env database and could bootstrap synthetic privileged accounts there without a dedicated target check.
infrastructure.fix: Abort production or a missing/non-dedicated database name before importing Prisma. Allow explicit _e2e_, _manual_, _test and _review_ markers.
infrastructure.regression: VM executes real pre-Prisma script prefixes for forbidden and allowed synthetic environments.

infrastructure.risk: Several manual rollback SQL files delete health/history/consent rows or columns and have warning comments rather than empty-data guards. They are not called from runtime or migrate deploy.
infrastructure.proposed_minimum: Use additive schema plus previous compatible binary in production; any data rollback requires reviewed compensating migration, backup and isolated rehearsal. Deployment guide now states this explicitly.

infrastructure.risk: pg connection timeout defaults to 0; SELECT 1 readiness has no service deadline. A black-holed DB connection may stall health responses until network/probe deadlines.
infrastructure.proposed_minimum: Set tested provider-appropriate connection/query and external probe timeouts before deployment; choose values with the selected host rather than inventing an SLO.
infrastructure.limit: No failure was injected into running services or real DB.

infrastructure.risk: No .github/CI pipeline exists. Jest collects service/guard coverage when requested but defines no coverageThreshold; passing test counts do not prove the stated 80 percent threshold.
infrastructure.proposed_minimum: Measure actual coverage and connect chosen platform quality gates; root explicitly declined generic new CI in this pass.

infrastructure.risk: Original hardcoded nonexistent checkout cwd removed. Launcher uses checkout-relative API and mobile workspace commands; no manual service started or stopped during verification.
